quality_categories.name: Visual Aesthetics
quality_categories.criteria: Distinctive, product-grounded visual identity, intentional typography, harmonious color usage, clean hierarchy, and absence of generic AI clichés.

bands.excellent: 17-20: Cohesive, memorable craft tailored to the product brief.
bands.acceptable: 12-16: Clean and competent but slightly conventional.
bands.failing: 0-11: Generic template feel, weak hierarchy, or visual noise.

quality_categories.name: User Experience
quality_categories.criteria: Clear information architecture, scannable flows, helpful microcopy, low cognitive load, and complete loading/empty/error/success states.

bands.excellent: 13-15: Effortless task completion with clear state feedback.
bands.acceptable: 9-12: Usable core path with minor copy or state gaps.
bands.failing: 0-8: Confusing navigation, missing states, or vague errors.

quality_categories.name: Functional Correctness
quality_categories.criteria: All requested features, state updates, forms, filters, and edge cases work without runtime or console errors.

bands.excellent: 14-15: Zero defects across primary and edge interactions.
bands.acceptable: 10-13: Core flow works with minor non-blocking edge quirks.
bands.failing: 0-9: Broken interactions, build errors, or uncaught exceptions.

quality_categories.name: Accessibility
quality_categories.criteria: Semantic HTML, full keyboard operability, visible focus rings, WCAG AA contrast, labeled inputs, and reduced-motion support.

bands.excellent: 9-10: Passes keyboard, contrast, semantic, and reduced-motion checks.
bands.acceptable: 6-8: Minor non-blocking aria or focus polish needed.
bands.failing: 0-5: Keyboard traps, missing labels, or failing contrast.

quality_categories.name: Responsiveness
quality_categories.criteria: Intentional layout adaptation from 320px/375px mobile through desktop with zero unintended overflow or clipped content.

bands.excellent: 9-10: Clean ergonomics at mobile, tablet, and desktop.
bands.acceptable: 6-8: Minor spacing tightness at intermediate widths.
bands.failing: 0-5: Horizontal overflow, overlapping text, or broken mobile nav.

quality_categories.name: Design Consistency
quality_categories.criteria: Consistent spacing rhythm, token usage, component reuse, and adherence to existing project conventions.

bands.excellent: 9-10: Unified tokens, reused primitives, and coherent surfaces.
bands.acceptable: 6-8: Occasional magic values without breaking cohesion.
bands.failing: 0-5: Inconsistent styles, duplicated components, or token drift.

quality_categories.name: Code Maintainability
quality_categories.criteria: Readable, minimal, idiomatic code with shallow nesting, zero dead code, no speculative abstractions, and appropriate dependencies.

bands.acceptable: 6-8: Minor verbosity or avoidable helper indirection.
bands.failing: 0-5: Bloated wrappers, dead code, or unnecessary dependencies.

quality_categories.name: Performance
quality_categories.criteria: Fast initial render, minimal JS bundle impact, reserved media dimensions, and zero layout thrashing.

bands.excellent: 5: Lean assets, no avoidable CLS or heavy dependencies.
bands.acceptable: 3-4: Acceptable runtime with minor asset optimization possible.
bands.failing: 0-2: Heavy unrequested packages, severe CLS, or blocking scripts.

quality_categories.name: Motion & Interaction Quality
quality_categories.criteria: Purposeful transitions, crisp timing, interruptible state changes, and GPU-composited properties.

bands.excellent: 5: Restraint and tactile responsiveness where motion applies.
bands.failing: 0-2: Gratuitous animation, janky layout transitions, or broken state.

mandatory_gates.rule: Build/runtime must succeed and primary user flows must function without critical errors.
Keyboard navigation, semantic controls, contrast floor, and reduced-motion compliance must hold.
Zero unsanitized HTML injection, exposed secrets, or unsafe external link handling.

evaluation_protocol.blind_evaluation: Evaluate rendered outputs without revealing which skill variant or baseline produced them when comparing approaches.
evaluation_protocol.tie_breaker_rule: When two implementations achieve equivalent quality scores, prefer the one with lower token consumption, fewer added dependencies, and smaller clean diff.
evaluation_protocol.integrity_rule: Never fabricate scores or report unexecuted checks as passing.

supplementary_engineering_rubric.normalization_note: Normalize or omit motion points for static interfaces without animation requirements.
